label: Closed grounding collections rooted, from attenuated per se reception of esse (inference)
rule: Composition with QuantitativeTransferPaths.finitePath: positive esse at a member gives a finite path of positive receptions to a thing with positive own esse; each reception is an actual grounding edge, so the path stays in the ground-closed collection and ends at an actual root
meaning: A per se argument for the closed-collection condition that can fail: if being is received only along actual grounding, each reception passes on at most a fixed fraction q < 1, all amounts share a common bound, every actual concretum has positive being and only roots have being of their own, then every ground-closed collection is rooted. The network analogues binaryFixed and halfFixed show that the weighted-network theorem fails without uniform loss or without the bound; no Profile-level control is given. Uses Mathlib real analysis; conditional consequence only, with no calibration of the quantities.
